recurring_entries_party_shape.name: recurring_entries_party_shape
recurring_entries_party_shape.value:
("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'bill' and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is not null and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is null)
       or ("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'invoice' and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is not null and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is null)
       or ("recurring_entries"."kind"::text = 'journal' and "recurring_entries"."vendor_id" is null and "recurring_entries"."customer_id" is null)

documents_filed_at_requires_folder.name: documents_filed_at_requires_folder
documents_filed_at_requires_folder.value: "documents"."folder_id" is not null or "documents"."filed_at" is null

crm_affiliations_primary_idx.name: crm_affiliations_primary_idx
crm_affiliations_primary_idx.where: is_primary = true and ended_on is null

crm_pipelines_default_idx.name: crm_pipelines_default_idx
crm_pipelines_default_idx.where: is_default = true and archived_at is null

work_items_starts_before_due.name: work_items_starts_before_due
work_items_starts_before_due.value: "work_items"."starts_on" is null or "work_items"."due_on" is null or "work_items"."starts_on" <= "work_items"."due_on"
